title: Margins at Ds optima beyond conditional centering and d_psi=1
statement: Determine the asymptotic margin behaviour of global finite Ds optima outside DS15's class: (a) laws with E[S_lam|shat] != 0, where the projection tax has a Theta(1) population component on efficient-score intervals, so the population supremum may be attained at nondegenerate quantizers and the margins may hold at optima; (b) d_psi > 1, where the dichotomy reduces to the open uniqueness/rigidity theory of the vector D problem on the efficient score (ties into OP8/C2); (c) exchange-stable non-global sequences, for which DS15 asserts nothing. Measured: non-centered laws (mix3, tiny_cluster) keep macroscopic binned nuisance blocks at exact optima through N=18 while the Gaussian laws' blocks collapse (N-DS-MARGINS-TREND).
